notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Game Update:[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44147870/5582ef170194be8756a4538f20cffbef1b52f45d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] We have fixed the bug where unused [The Fruit of Life] would disappear after [Ragnarok].
[*] Now, you can immediately use [Gungnir] and [The Wisdom of Mimir] after [Ragnarok].
　※[Gungnir] and [Mimir's Wisdom] must be unlocked.
[*] We have made minor adjustments to the game's balance to enhance the speed of producing Stellar.
[*] Added zoom-in and zoom-out buttons to the [Roots of the Yggdrasil] 
[/list]
